telc C1 Exam: Format and Hochschule Comparison

Compare general telc Deutsch C1 with C1 Hochschule, then plan reading, language elements, writing and speaking using official format and scoring guidance.

telc Deutsch C1 · Source checked 14 November 2026

See the exam formatOfficial mock and sources

Choose the correct examination

This page focuses on general telc Deutsch C1. C1 Hochschule is a separate examination aimed at university contexts; C1 Beruf is another named product. Confirm the exact accepted certificate with the receiving institution instead of choosing by level alone.

Compare the official C1 Hochschule page and download its separate mock. University acceptance depends on the institution and programme; obtain confirmation of the exact certificate before booking.

Exam format and timing

Published task times; arrival, breaks and appointment length are separate.
PartTask timeWhat to check
Reading and language elements90 minutes combinedThree reading parts and one language-elements part; a 20-minute break is listed.
ListeningAbout 40 minutesThree parts.
Writing70 minutesOne extended written response.
SpeakingAbout 16 minutesUsually two candidates, with 20 minutes of preparation.

These are the published standard task times, not a promise of total appointment length. Follow the centre’s instructions for your booked format, breaks and any approved accommodations.

Scoring and partial examinations

The officially linked general C1 mock lists 214 points in total, with minima of 99 in the written part and 29 in the oral part, for at least 128 overall. Use these published values rather than inventing a rounding rule from a percentage.

The product page allows partial examinations. Ask the centre about written/oral registration, credit periods and the current booking conditions before arranging a resit.

Switching from Goethe C1?

Goethe C1 uses four independently assessed modules. General telc C1 uses a written/oral structure with language elements. C1 Hochschule has a separate academic focus even where top-level timings resemble general C1; matching clocks do not make the tasks or certificate identical.

Read the Goethe C1 guide before transferring a study plan between providers.

Prepare each skill

Reading and language elements

Work with complex arguments and paragraph links. Explain the function of a connector and how a claim is qualified before choosing an option. Keep a record of register and collocation errors.

Listening

Practise following longer arguments while noting only the information the task needs. Distinguish an example from the main conclusion and a reported view from the speaker’s position.

Writing

Build a coherent extended response with a clear line of argument, relevant examples and controlled register. Plan before drafting and edit for repetition, logical jumps and imprecise reference words.

Speaking

Rehearse a structured contribution and a responsive discussion. Practise summarising another person’s argument accurately before evaluating it, without replacing their view with your own.

Build a preparation sequence

The following is Klarweg’s study advice, not an official schedule or a promise that a set number of weeks produces this level. Adjust the sequence after a diagnostic attempt.

  1. Match the variant. Download the general C1 mock and compare its title with the booked certificate. If university admission is the goal, check the institution’s named requirement first.
  2. Refine precision. Rewrite one argument in a clearer structure, qualify an overgeneralisation and replace vague references with explicit ones.
  3. Test independence. Rehearse the timed written sequence and a discussion with unplanned follow-up questions. Use the official criteria to identify weaknesses.

Mistakes to avoid

  • Assuming general C1 and C1 Hochschule are interchangeable certificates.
  • Using complex sentences that obscure the argument or change the source meaning.
  • Applying old material from a different provider without checking the examination name.

Check readiness before booking

  • I have confirmation of which C1 certificate the institution accepts.
  • I can sustain a clear argument without padding.
  • I can distinguish source information, inference and opinion.
  • I have assessed both written and oral performance against the right mock.

Use the official answer key for objective items. For writing and speaking, compare the published criteria and seek specific feedback; an unchecked self-score is not a reliable pass prediction.

Common questions

Does general telc C1 equal C1 Hochschule?

They share the CEFR level but are separate named examinations. Check the university’s stated certificate requirement and use the correct official mock.

Does similar timing mean the same test?

No. The general and Hochschule variants can share timing blocks while differing in purpose and task content.

Fees, dates and your exam centre

Ask the examination centre for the current fee, available date, full examination name, delivery format, cancellation terms and identification rules. This guide does not sell places, guarantee availability or quote a nationwide fee.

Find an examination centre through telc and confirm that it offers your exact test. If a certificate is needed for admission, work or an official process, confirm acceptance with the receiving organisation.
